name: Astrid Karlsson
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, starting with a degree in computer science and a passion for problem-solving. She spent several years in the tech industry, developing IT solutions for various companies, before her love for racing drew her in. Her first role in motorsport was with a smaller team, where she built their IT infrastructure from the ground up. This experience honed her technical skills and ignited her passion for the sport.

Now at Signature Racing, Astrid is responsible for maintaining and improving the team's IT systems, ensuring seamless data flow between departments and trackside operations. She prides herself on her ability to stay calm under pressure and her proactive approach to identifying potential issues before they arise. Her flexible personality makes her adaptable to the ever-changing demands of the racing world, and she's always looking for innovative ways to leverage technology to improve the team's performance. What sets her apart is her talent for bridging the gap between the technical and racing sides of the team, translating complex IT jargon into actionable insights for the engineers and drivers.

physical.hairStyle: Straight, shoulder-length hair, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid is of average height with a focused, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small Rubik's Cube and solves it during stressful meetings.
Has an encyclopedic knowledge of 80s arcade games and occasionally makes racing analogies using them.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard with extremely loud key clicks, much to the annoyance of her colleagues.
